$comment: Orbits by seed (docs/proposals/REALISTIC_WORLD.md §8; owner 2026-11-12: "Orbits should be seed determined."). A world that rolls an orbit (a Realistic world: its climate reads the sky) draws one from its seed in its preset's ranges at creation (dwell_look::orbits Orbit::roll) and keeps it as world settings (the clock in CLOCK, the moon's phase in MOON_PHASE, the rest in CELESTIAL, ADR 0054), so a later build's ranges never change its sky. Every other world keeps today's orbit (Orbit::today, read from daynight.json: pole 90 − sunPath.noonElevationDeg, pole yaw sunPath.riseYawDeg, distance 1, no tilt, today's clock and moon). presets: the New world → More options Sky choices (owner: "proposed ranges, fixed day, day varies, more extreme with hotter/colder"), `default` first and the default; each roll's entries are [min, max] ranges (a range of one value pins it): poleDeg the celestial pole's height over face A's horizon (face A's latitude, N; face B's the same S; the noon sun 90° − poleDeg), poleYawDeg its yaw (the sun's rising point, as sunPath.riseYawDeg), distance from the sun (1 today's; the climate's offset 288 K × (distance^−½ − 1) clamped to limits.offsetC), tiltDeg the axial tilt (seasons, O4; rolled within [min, min(max, limits.maxPoleDeg − poleDeg)], so a high-latitude world has mild seasons), yearDays the year in world days, yearPhase where a new world starts in it (0 spring), dayLengthS a whole day and night (s, rounded to whole seconds), dayShare face A's daylight share of it (face B has the rest), moon its month (cycleDays, new to new), inclinationDeg to the sun's path, nodeDeg and its phase at day 0; its distance is kept (its size in the sky, owner MOON_WORLD.md §12 Q8). limits: what every preset must keep for play (DAY_NIGHT.md, §8.4): poleDeg + tiltDeg ≤ maxPoleDeg (the noon sun high enough), both faces' daylight share within dayShare, the temperature offset within offsetC (°C). Run `node shared/look/orbits.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-look/src/orbits.gen.rs or client/src/ui/skyPresets.gen.ts is stale. Prototype tuning.

default.label: Default

day_varies.label: Day varies
day_varies.description: As Default, with the day's length and its daylight rolled a little.
